# Copilot Usage Notes

- **Purpose & Stack**: Field-worker Flutter app for cattle tagging, retagging, and claim flows built with GetX and custom widgets; start point in [lib/main.dart#L1-L40](lib/main.dart#L1-L40). Uses get_it for lightweight DI and GetX navigation/state.
- **Bootstrap & DI**: Main registers `FormValidations` and `SnackbarHelper` singletons plus a global `DeviceController`; `Get.put(AppController())` happens inside `MyApp` ([lib/main.dart#L14-L37](lib/main.dart#L14-L37), [lib/dependency_injection.dart#L1-L10](lib/dependency_injection.dart#L1-L10), [lib/device_controller.dart#L1-L36](lib/device_controller.dart#L1-L36)). Ensure `getTemporaryDirectory()` remains awaited before DI setup.
- **Routing pattern**: Route names live in [lib/routes/common/common_app_pages.dart#L1-L12](lib/routes/common/common_app_pages.dart#L1-L12); pages are registered as `GetPage`s in [lib/routes/common/common_app_routes.dart#L1-L66](lib/routes/common/common_app_routes.dart#L1-L66) and aggregated via [lib/routes/app_routes.dart#L1-L7](lib/routes/app_routes.dart#L1-L7). New screens need a `Bindings` class, controller, and page wired here.
- **State/UI conventions**: Screens typically use `GetBuilder<Controller>(init: Controller(), ...)` with matching `Bindings` for navigation-created instances. Layout sizing uses `hp/wp/dp` helpers tied to `Get.width/Get.height` ([lib/utils/responsive.dart#L1-L20](lib/utils/responsive.dart#L1-L20)). Colors come from [lib/utils/colors.dart#L1-L86](lib/utils/colors.dart#L1-L86).
- **Reusable widgets**: Standard app bars, buttons, and fields come from [lib/widgets/customappbar.dart#L1-L54](lib/widgets/customappbar.dart#L1-L54), [lib/widgets/customcontainer.dart#L1-L61](lib/widgets/customcontainer.dart#L1-L61), [lib/widgets/text_field.dart#L1-L101](lib/widgets/text_field.dart#L1-L101). File/image selection uses [lib/widgets/custom_camera_button.dart#L1-L46](lib/widgets/custom_camera_button.dart#L1-L46) and the `customRow` preview helper in [lib/widgets/custom_row.dart#L1-L95](lib/widgets/custom_row.dart#L1-L95). Snackbar helper is DI-backed (`showSnackBar`) in [lib/widgets/snackbar_widget.dart#L1-L52](lib/widgets/snackbar_widget.dart#L1-L52).
- **Login flow**: `LoginController` posts to `http://localhost:3001/auth/field-worker/login`, injecting device info in the payload and showing a modal loader ([lib/pages/login/login_controller.dart#L1-L122](lib/pages/login/login_controller.dart#L1-L122)). Email vs mobile login toggles are plain booleans; keep form validation via `formValidation.validation` ([lib/utils/validation_utils.dart#L1-L63](lib/utils/validation_utils.dart#L1-L63)).
- **Tagging search**: `TaggingScreen` captures search criteria and toggles a static list; selecting an item pushes Tagging Data with the lead payload ([lib/pages/tagging/tagging_controller.dart#L1-L88](lib/pages/tagging/tagging_controller.dart#L1-L88), [lib/pages/tagging/tagging_screen.dart#L1-L180](lib/pages/tagging/tagging_screen.dart#L1-L180)). `listshow` drives whether results appear; maintain it when adding filters.
- **Tagging/Retagging/Claim detail form**: `TaggingDataScreen` is multipurpose; arguments `manualtagging`, `retagging`, and `isclaim` switch titles, tag-number fields, and reason dropdowns ([lib/pages/tagging_data_screen.dart/tagging_data_controller.dart#L1-L158](lib/pages/tagging_data_screen.dart/tagging_data_controller.dart#L1-L158), [lib/pages/tagging_data_screen.dart/tagging_data_screen.dart#L1-L220](lib/pages/tagging_data_screen.dart/tagging_data_screen.dart#L1-L220)). Date/time pickers set `dateofdeathcontroller`/`timeofdeathcontroller`; `isimage` selects which attachment slot is written.
- **KYC capture**: `KycScreen` collects Aadhar/PAN/bank images via `customRow`; `isimage` drives which Rx<File> gets filled in the controller. `savekyc()` shows a loader then navigates to Cattle with `retagging`/`ischangepage` flags preserved ([lib/pages/kyc/kyc_controller.dart#L1-L93](lib/pages/kyc/kyc_controller.dart#L1-L93), [lib/pages/kyc/kyc_screen.dart#L1-L170](lib/pages/kyc/kyc_screen.dart#L1-L170)).
- **Cattle capture**: `Cattlescreen` is reused for tagging, retagging, and claim via `ischangepage`/`retagging` args; species/breed/appearance options live in `CattleController` lists. Image slots (ear tag, head/side/back, extras) map to `isimage` indices; videos use `isvideo`. `savecattle()` and `saveclaim()` require at least one photo before advancing to farmer details ([lib/pages/cattle/cattle_controller.dart#L1-L200](lib/pages/cattle/cattle_controller.dart#L1-L200), [lib/pages/cattle/cattle_controller.dart#L401-L470](lib/pages/cattle/cattle_controller.dart#L401-L470), [lib/pages/cattle/cattle_screen.dart#L1-L200](lib/pages/cattle/cattle_screen.dart#L1-L200)).
- **Claim/Retagging lists**: `ClaimScreen` lists pending items (currently static) and routes to Tagging Data with `isclaim`/`retagging` flags after a loader ([lib/pages/claim/claim_sceen.dart#L1-L140](lib/pages/claim/claim_sceen.dart#L1-L140)).
- **Data display**: Static demo data for attended leads lives in [lib/pages/data_display/data_display_controller.dart#L1-L110](lib/pages/data_display/data_display_controller.dart#L1-L110); tapping navigates to owner detail or Tagging Data. Titles change based on args in [lib/pages/data_display/data_display_screen.dart#L1-L120](lib/pages/data_display/data_display_screen.dart#L1-L120).
- **Farmer summary**: Final shareable summary view uses `ScreenshotController` and `share_plus`; share/home buttons in [lib/pages/farmer_details/farmer_details_page.dart#L1-L180](lib/pages/farmer_details/farmer_details_page.dart#L1-L180). Keep containers inside `Screenshot` to include content in captures.
- **API reference**: High-level endpoint plan (login/device registration, tagging/retagging/claim search and updates, certificates) documented in [lib/pages/kyc/RRM-Apis.txt#L1-L90](lib/pages/kyc/RRM-Apis.txt#L1-L90); currently only login is wired. Align future calls with these paths and flag-driven flows above.
- **Assets & responsive**: Assets whitelisted under `assets/images`, `assets/Tagging_Sample`, `assets/Claim_Sample`, `assets/kyc` ([pubspec.yaml#L51-L66](pubspec.yaml#L51-L66)). Screens assume `GetMaterialApp` with textScaler locked at 1.0; prefer hp/wp/dp sizing to keep layout consistent.
- **Error/success UX**: Loading uses `LoadingAnimationWidget.staggeredDotsWave` inside `Get.dialog`; ensure dialogs are closed (`Get.back()`) on both success and failure. Use `showSnackBar` with `SNACK.SUCCESS`/`FAILED` enums for messaging ([lib/utils/enum_utils.dart#L1-L4](lib/utils/enum_utils.dart#L1-L4)).
- **Build/test**: Standard Flutter commands: `flutter pub get`, `flutter run`, `flutter test`. Requires Dart 3.8 and Flutter SDK with the listed plugins (camera/gallery/image/video pickers, get, get_it, intl, loading_animation_widget, screenshot, share_plus).
- **Adding screens/features**: Follow the binding/controller/page triad; register the page in `CommonRoutes`, add a route constant, and use `Get.toNamed`/`arguments` to pass flags so reused screens render correctly. Mirror existing patterns for loaders and attachment pickers to stay consistent.
